title: The Autumn Harvest
seo_title: Where to Find Acorns, Chestnuts and Figs This Autumn
meta_description: Every tree we map whose best moment is its crop: acorns, chestnuts, figs and olives, grouped by the month they come, from August into November.
intro: A tree at fruiting is a different kind of visit. There is nothing much to look at up in the crown and everything on the ground: acorns underfoot by the thousand in a mast year, sweet chestnuts split out of their cases, figs going soft on the paving, olives knocked down onto sheets. This page ranks every tree we map whose best moment is its crop, grouped by the month it comes, which in our data runs from August into November and peaks hard in September and October. Two things worth saying plainly. Most of these are protected trees and several are the only one of their kind in their city, so look at what has fallen and leave what is still on the branch. And not all of it is food, whatever it looks like: a yew's red arils sit around a seed that is poisonous.
